description: Task 21: Certify the Merchant pilot candidate. Run PILOT.md scenarios through reference-buyer. Perform independent receipt verification. Build evidence bundle with signed Capability Manifest. Create requirement traceability matrix linking each PILOT.md requirement to its test evidence.
steps: Create packages/merchant-application/src/pilot-certification.ts with PilotCertification class: (a) runCertificationSuite(scenarios, referenceBuyer) executes all scenarios, (b) collectEvidenceBundle() gathers test results, receipts, findings, and manifest, (c) signCertificationManifest() produces a CTP-signed capability manifest with evidence hashes, (d) CertificationResult type with pass/fail per scenario

Create packages/merchant-application/src/requirement-traceability.ts with: (a) RequirementLink type (requirementId, pilotMdSection, testScenarioId, evidenceIds, status), (b) buildTraceabilityMatrix() mapping each PILOT.md requirement to its test evidence, (c) PILOT_REQUIREMENTS constant enumerating all 14 released operation candidates from PILOT.md section 3, (d) validateTraceability() ensuring no requirement has missing evidence

Create packages/merchant-application/src/evidence-bundle.ts with: (a) EvidenceBundle type (scenarios results, receipts, findings, manifest snapshot, timestamp, version), (b) buildEvidenceBundle() aggregates all certification artifacts, (c) signBundle() produces CTP-signed envelope over the bundle digest, (d) verifyBundle() independently verifies the signed bundle

Create packages/merchant-application/src/pilot-certification.test.ts testing: (a) certification suite runs all scenarios and produces results, (b) evidence bundle contains all required artifacts, (c) signed capability manifest has correct evidence hashes, (d) traceability matrix covers all PILOT.md requirements, (e) missing evidence is detected and reported
Update packages/merchant-application/src/index.ts to export pilot-certification, requirement-traceability, evidence-bundle modules
acceptance_criteria: PilotCertification runs all PILOT.md scenarios through reference-buyer infrastructure
Independent receipt verification validates every issued receipt in the suite
Evidence bundle contains signed Capability Manifest with evidence hashes
Requirement traceability matrix links each PILOT.md released operation to test evidence
No requirement has missing evidence (validateTraceability passes)
Signed manifest and bundle are independently verifiable via CTP signature verification
verification: export NVM_DIR=/opt/toolchains/.nvm && source $NVM_DIR/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && cd /projects/sandbox/counterX && pnpm --filter @counter/merchant-application build && pnpm --filter @counter/merchant-application test
findings: 199 total tests passing in merchant-application (30 new). Pilot certification, requirement traceability matrix (14 PILOT.md operations), evidence bundle with CTP-signed manifest.
